feeds.title: New Zealand Wine Directory
feeds.description: Started as a hobby website as 'NZ Wine Links' back in 2002, The New Zealand Wine Directory has developed into a valuable online resource, containing over 4,000 links to everything about New Zealand Wine online. The blog s a 'free-to-use' online resource, containing links to thousands of businesses across New Zealand's Wine Industry.

feeds.title: Two Paddocks Blog
feeds.description: We started in 1993 with modest ambitions and first planted five acres of pinot noir at our original little vineyard at Gibbston, Central Otago in the deep south of New Zealand.

feeds.title: Joelle Thomson Blog
feeds.description: This is my online magazine featuring stories, reviews and details of my wine courses.I am a journalist, author, and wine writer and live in Martinborough, a remote rural wine village in the Wairarapa, 90 minutes' hilly drive from Wellington city.

feeds.title: Yvonne Lorkin
feeds.description: I'm super proud to be the co-founder and CTO (Chief Tasting Officer) of WineFriend, the greatest personalized wine delivery service in all the land. We match wine to people. We help our subscribers navigate the crazy-vast number of wines out there in the marketplace by pairing them with wines that only suit their individual tastes through our interesting blog. Wines that are delicious, unique, and definitely not seen in your average supermarket.

feeds.title: Lawsons Dry Hills News
feeds.description: The original company vineyard was planted in 1982 by Ross and Barbara Lawson, who launched Lawson's Dry Hills label some ten years later, in 1992. Today, the company's wines include Sauvignon Blanc, Riesling, Chardonnay, Pinot Gris, Pinot Noir, and our famous Gewürztraminer, all made from fruit grown in the Wairau, Waihopai, Omaka, and Awatere Valleys. Read their blog and learn more about the company, its vineyards, wine collection, industry news, and more.

feeds.title: WineFolio
feeds.description: WineFolio is a collection of writing about New Zealand Wine. It covers all the information about the wine market, and vineyards and features articles on topics regarding the vineyards and the finished product available to sip in the market.

feeds.title: MermaidMary News
feeds.description: Mary-Therese Blair aka MermaidMary loves Wine adventuress, is an organics advocate, and passionate New Zealander. In her blog, she covers topics such as latest wines in the market, wine tasting reviews, recipes, industry news,and other related information.

feeds.title: Not Serious Wine Chats
feeds.description: Morv, Pete, Ash & John chat to interesting people who drink interesting stuff. It should be interesting but not serious. Maybe educational, but not serious.

feeds.title: Dhall & Nash Fine Wines Blog
feeds.description: Wines, Words and Wonders. Dhall & Nash's blog reviews and profiles wines from our extensive portfolio, along with team updates and regional travels.

feeds.title: Tohu Wines Blog
feeds.description: Tohu Wines is New Zealand's first Maori owned wine company. Based in Marlborough we produce quality wines from our stunning Awatere and Waihopai Valley vineyards. We also produce aromatics from Nelson and Chardonnay from Gisborne.

feeds.title: Wine Racks NZ Blog
feeds.description: Get some inspiration for your next wine project. We've provided wine storage solutions all around NZ for cellars both big and small thanks to the innovative label forward wall mounted metal wine racking system by VintageView.

feeds.title: Quartz Reef Wines Blog
feeds.description: In the heart of Central Otago, Quartz Reef specializes in creating premium organic and biodynamic wines. As a team, we work in harmony with nature to create sensory wines and experiences that capture the purest expressions of our place. Combining old-world traditions with the insight and innovation of the new to realize the beauty and potential of our single vineyard estate in the sub-region of Bendigo.

feeds.title: Brockenchack Wines Blog
feeds.description: For us, every season is wine season, but certain wines pair better with seasonal dishes. In our family, Autumn resonates with Chardonnay, Pinot Noir & Grenache. Unearth our range of single vineyard wines, direct from our family vineyard in the Barossa, to your family table here in NZ.

feeds.title: The Shout
feeds.description: About The Shout New Zealand is New Zealand's independent source of news, insight, business advice and opinion for the hospitality and liquor sectors. Latest news, features and analysis for the New Zealand trade liquor industry - pubs, bars, clubs, wineries, breweries, supermarkets, liquor stores. Trends and stats across beer, wine and spirits, wine reviews with Cameron Douglas MS.

feeds.title: Coal Pit Wines Blog
feeds.description: Coal Pit is a boutique family vineyard in Central Otago, New Zealand. We are committed to producing world-class wines from our certified organic vineyard and on-site winery.

feeds.title: Whitehaven Wines Blog
feeds.description: Established in 1994 in the heart of the internationally renowned Marlborough region, Whitehaven is the realisation of the White family's vision to create a respected and critically acclaimed winery. Sailing the Pacific, they set a new course for the Marlborough Sounds, dropped anchor and launched a wine label Whitehaven.

feeds.title: Rapaura Springs Blog
feeds.description: Each bottle of Rapaura Springs tells a story of a lifetime in Marlborough of water, wine, and of vineyards. Follow their blog and Read the latest news from Rapaura Springs, Marlborough, New Zealand.

feeds.title: Caroha » Wine Tips
feeds.description: Caroha is a place where food lovers and home cooks can find easy-to-make, from-scratch recipes that celebrate simple but high-quality ingredients. My easy-spelt bread is a great example. Follow my blog and ke a seat at my table as I share homemade food from scratch, delicious wines and easy ways of turning meals into memories.

feeds.title: Celia Hay Blog
feeds.description: The Celia Hay Blog covers topics related to vineyards, farming, management of vineyards, recipes, industry updates, and the latest news.

feeds.title: Regional Wines Blog
feeds.description: Regional Wine is New Zealand's fine wine, beer and spirits online supplier. We stock beverages from every part of the world as well as New Zealand.

feeds.title: Prophet's Rock Blog
feeds.description: Originally from New Zealand, winemaker Paul Pujol has always been drawn to the Pinot Noirs and aromatic whites of France. He joined Prophet's Rock after a six-year around the world odyssey chasing these varietals, travels palpable in the wines he makes today.

feeds.title: Everyday Wine Blog
feeds.description: Here the team at Everday chats about and to winemakers, artists, and film directors about minimal intervention winemaking, organic viticulture, and whatever natural wines we are vibing right now.

feeds.title: Kahurangi Wine Blog
feeds.description: At Kahurangi, we are all about bringing people together helping our customers discover great value, and premium wines to share with friends. Our story began in 1973 with the planting of our Riesling vines some of the oldest in the South Island. The Kahurangi brand was born in 1998 and now brings together four families with a shared desire to bring people wines they will love.

feeds.title: Hawkshead Wine Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to our Gibbston Valley vineyard, home to internationally acclaimed Pinot Noir and the perfect destination for purchasing the very finest of New Zealand's Central Otago wine. Pinot Noir, Pinot Gris, Pinot Blanc, Riesling, and Rose wines are available to purchase online.

feeds.title: Pembroke Wines Blog
feeds.description: PWSW is a 'home from home' for the local community & visitors alike. With an extensive selection of exclusive alcohols from all over the world, where else can you relax after a hard day and choose from over 50 craft beers, 80 whiskeys & an ever-changing international wine list (to suit every budget) in the lounge bar/tasting room before making your selection to take home for the evening ahead.

feeds.title: Stonecroft News
feeds.description: Small organic winery in Hawke's Bay New Zealand. It is a Boutique winery with a small cellar door in the Gimblett Gravels Wine Growing District.

feeds.title: Grasshopper Rock Blog
feeds.description: Planted in 2003, Grasshopper Rock is one of the world's southernmost vineyards, dedicated exclusively to Central Otago Pinot Noir. Follow their blog and learn more about their farms, vineyards, and more.
